action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal White moves at depth 4 to identify the strongest continuation after Black's king retreat to c6.
action.rationale: Broad search is required and no prior analyses exist. The position is winning (Black king on c6, White queen on e5, bishop a5, knight c7 and h8), so I want a full depth-4 scan of all roots before selecting a candidate to verify. Nodes are capped at 3000 (half budget) per broad-search rule.
